data.title: Giving a Chonburi plant a shift-level view of loss
data.summary: A consumer-goods plant moved OEE from a weekly spreadsheet to a supervisor routine that acted inside the shift.
data.challenge: Machine data existed but stop reasons were entered inconsistently. The plant could explain last month but not the last hour.
data.strategy: We instrumented the constraint line first and co-designed a small set of stop reasons with supervisors. The data model was built to extend to other lines without redefinition.
data.implementation: Edge gateways collected cycle and stop signals without touching the control network. A supervisor screen and shift handover routine were introduced, then extended to two more lines after eight weeks.
